notes.title: Let's play Dolmenjord - Vilking Islands!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41937677/42c6d9a83597a15644ec5ec1dc89ad3c7411956e.png[/img]

Dolmenjord is a game inspired by Norse mythology, where Vikings need help to organize their buildings and villages and thus solve the puzzles and dominate new lands.

It is available now!

Great for Nordic culture fans who love to be challenged with logic puzzles.

Set up each village according to the rules:
- Place all the available houses and walkway pieces.
- Every house must face the walkway.
-  The completed walkway must give access to the port.

The puzzles are simple in the early islands, but it gets challenging as you advance in the exploration. If you prefer a more relaxing journey, that's fine!
Whenever you want, you can enable the Casual Mode.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41937677/0577d939cf97d6c0faadc7f7a473c1082d2151f5.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Island Farmer is available now!
notes.content:
[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35765065/344c38eb4bc78bc1ddf48368fa86f55d7ba57f8f.jpg[/img]

Farms are set up in islands over calm and clear water.
In this tiny fantasy experience, that is easy to do and very relaxing, just like a 3D jigsaw puzzle.

Swap the blocks to recreate the desired island and it will compose the archipelago.

There is no time limit, logic challenges, or resources to manage, so you can calmly just focus on the core mechanics while listening to a soothing soundtrack.
[list]
[*] Click on two blocks to swap them,
[*] Turn the camera around the island;
[*] Zoom in and out to see details or the big picture;
[*] Preview the expected arrangement.
[/list]
As you progress building the islands, see your archipelago expand and evolve in the background.
With clear skies, fresh air, and crystal clear water, among animals and listening to the sounds of nature.


Play it now!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1564560/Island_Farmer__Jigsaw_Puzzle/

notes.title: Pathfinders: Memories - Full version released!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37614392/f7349379270a52ec7d8c29a72d348bb8442a7fd1.jpg[/img]

Pathfinders: Memories has just been released in Full Version!

Use your memory to help Pathfinders travel through time visiting ancient human civilizations and search for relics. The path to success is full of entrapments, obstacles, and enemies. Memorize them and draw the safe path for our heroes.

The final version adds these features:

- The final civilization - England in Industrial Revolution - is available, completing the total of six civilizations - Ancient Rome, Ancient Egypt, the Vikings, Mali Empire, the Arabs, and Industial England.

- The museum of the human civilizations - the gallery showcasing the relics found in each civilization can be visited at any time. Find all of them to complete the museum!

Play it now!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1294780/Pathfinders_Memories/


We thank everyone who supported us during Early Access by playing the game.

We are a small game studio focused on creating games that are simple but provide a pleasant experience to the player, mostly solving puzzles (either logic, word, jigsaw) in a relaxing environment, without timers or rush.

notes.title: Update with New Features!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37905734/a8851f3528273b8969020a122183f36986b389d5.jpg[/img]

Hi, 
We've updated the game with new features, motivated by community feedback.
We expect our players to have an even better experience when playing the game!

Here is what is new:
- A new pieces highlight mode. In addition to highlighting border pieces, now you can highlight pieces from a specific quadrant of the board;
- New shortcut keys to Preview the picture [b](P)[/b], Change background color [b](C)[/b], Shuffle the pieces [b](S)[/b];
- Zoom using the mouse wheel and drag the board using the mouse right button;
- Request for confirmation when selecting reset puzzle button;
- Selected parameters (language, sound, background) are kept even on full reset;
- When you click on a piece or a group of selected pieces, it is no longer being centralized around the mouse pointer 
- And other adjustments and bug corrections.

Thank you to everyone who has played, reviewed and provided feedback. 
[b]We will implement these changes in our other jigsaw puzzle games too, very soon.[/b]

Share your thoughts on these changes on the community hub.

Follow the Steam page of our studio to receive all the news about our games!
Go to https://store.steampowered.com/developer/menssana and click the Follow button!
